query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Prepare HubSpot launch assets for a paid event registration flow: assess payment-link feasibility, create a review-only automated confirmation email, create a disabled confirmation workflow, verify the assets remain inert, and attempt to create a custom-object registration ledger.
query_ground_truth.rationale: Building the registration workflow in a disabled state requires the workflow creation tool.

results.execution_guidance: Found 4 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Kadoa is an API-first platform that enables users to create, manage, and monitor data extraction workflows from unstructured data sources.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=kadoa. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="kadoa") to create a connection BEFORE executing any kadoa tools.

KADOA_CREATE_WORKFLOW_TRIGGER.description: Tool to create a trigger that fires when a source workflow emits an event. Use when you need to chain workflows together, triggering one workflow based on events from another. Common use case: trigger data processing workflow when scraping workflow finishes.

enabled.description: Whether the trigger is enabled. Set to false to temporarily disable without deleting.

eventType.description: Event type that triggers the target workflow. Most common: 'workflow_finished' to trigger when source completes successfully.

workflowId.description: ID of the source workflow that will emit events to trigger the target workflow

targetWorkflowId.description: ID of the workflow to trigger when the source workflow emits an event

KADOA_GET_WORKFLOWS.description: Retrieve a paginated list of workflows with optional filtering. Use this tool to list all workflows in your Kadoa account. You can filter by: - search: Find workflows by name, URL, or ID - state: Filter by workflow state (ACTIVE, PAUSED, ERROR, etc.) - monitoring: Filter by whether monitoring is enabled Returns workflow details including name, state, URLs, schema, and run statistics.

skip.description: Number of items to skip (offset) for pagination, must be >= 0

limit.description: Maximum number of workflows to return per page (1-100)

state.description: Filter by workflow state (e.g., ACTIVE, PAUSED, ERROR)

search.description: Search term to filter workflows by name, URL, or ID

monitoring.description: Filter workflows by monitoring status. True returns only monitored workflows, False returns only non-monitored workflows.

KADOA_GET_EVENT_TYPES.description: Tool to retrieve supported notification event types. Use when you need to enumerate available notification triggers.
